PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder) is a psychiatry clinic recognized for its exceptional performance in the quality of care provided to adults with ADHD. Within the context of the national evaluation of ADHD treatment quality, the clinic emerged as a notable local success story, contrasting with systemic and registration challenges faced in other areas such as Region Nordjylland and Region Hovedstaden [^src1].

The clinic's significance is primarily tied to its results on [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]], the first quality indicator for adults with ADHD in the national database annual report [^src1]. PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder) achieved a score of 83%, making it a high-performance outlier [^src1]. It was one of only three departments with a minimum of three patients to reach or exceed the 80% threshold for this metric [^src1]. The only other facilities to achieve similar outlier performance were [[pho-klinik-1-for-psykiatriske-lidelser-horsens|PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens]], which scored 82%, and [[pmi-klinik-for-depression-og-mani-midt|PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt]], which scored exactly 80% [^src1].
